The installer includes every retrained LoRA checkpoint currently published in
the project Hugging Face repository. The workflow initially selects step 1500;
choose steps 2000, 2250, 2500, 3000, 3500, or 4000 from the LoRA loader to
compare them under identical settings. The previous adapter remains available
as a baseline during testing.

Run this in the RunPod web terminal:

```bash
export HF_TOKEN="hf_..."
P=/workspace/comfyui-hoi4-portraits
COMFY_ROOT=/workspace/runpod-slim/ComfyUI
test -f "$COMFY_ROOT/main.py" || { echo "ComfyUI not found at $COMFY_ROOT; set COMFY_ROOT to the folder containing main.py."; exit 1; }
if test -d "$P/.git"; then git -C "$P" pull --ff-only; else git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/klimPaskov/comfyui-hoi4-portraits.git "$P"; fi
"$P/scripts/install_runpod.sh" "$COMFY_ROOT"
```

Restart ComfyUI after installation, close older workflow tabs, and reopen the
workflow from **Workflows → hoi4_portraits** so the new default and checkpoint
list are loaded.
